component.name: DiaDraw
component.summary: Diagrams as text, with a canvas that writes the text back

description.p: DiaDraw keeps a diagram as plain text: a model of people, systems and their relationships, and views of it. The canvas beside the text draws each view; moving, connecting, renaming or deleting on the canvas edits the text, so both always agree.
It imports Mermaid, PlantUML, Structurizr, draw.io and BPMN, and exports SVG, PNG, PDF, draw.io and BPMN.
